title: Lock screen: Add Shut Down and Restart buttons
line: The lock screen now has Restart and Shut Down buttons next to Sleep, Hibernate and Switch User.
explanation: The lock screen's action row only had Sleep, Hibernate and Switch User (added in 5.24), so restarting or turning off a locked computer meant typing the password first. The change adds Restart and Shut Down ActionButtons to LockScreenUi.qml, visible on SessionManagement's canReboot/canShutdown, which already honour the logout kiosk restriction and logind. They request the action without the logout confirmation dialog, because that dialog would open hidden behind the lock screen.

commits.message:
lockscreen: add Restart and Shut Down buttons

The lock screen only offered Sleep, Hibernate and Switch User, so turning
off or restarting a locked computer meant unlocking it first. Add Restart
and Shut Down buttons, shown when the session is allowed to do them.

BUG: 336369

patches.diff:
From 068f86c093ecc75cc245c74ffbf57c35f95f9194 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:39:57 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: add Restart and Shut Down buttons

The lock screen only offered Sleep, Hibernate and Switch User, so turning
off or restarting a locked computer meant unlocking it first. Add Restart
and Shut Down buttons, shown when the session is allowed to do them.

BUG: 336369
---
 .../contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml           | 14 ++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 14 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..831d900f4a 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -428,6 +428,20 @@ Item {
                             sessionManagement.switchUser();
                         }
                         visible: sessionManagement.canSwitchUser
+                    },
+                    ActionButton {
+                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter | Qt.AlignTop
+                        text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "&Restart")
+                        icon.name: "system-reboot"
+                        onClicked: sessionManagement.requestReboot(SessionManagement.ConfirmationMode.Skip)
+                        visible: sessionManagement.canReboot
+                    },
+                    ActionButton {
+                        Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter | Qt.AlignTop
+                        text: i18ndc("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "@action:button", "Shut &Down")
+                        icon.name: "system-shutdown"
+                        onClicked: sessionManagement.requestShutdown(SessionManagement.ConfirmationMode.Skip)
+                        visible: sessionManagement.canShutdown
                     }
                 ]
 
--
